sheets.prompt: Vehicle concept art for a science fiction exploration game: ONE small inherited family spaceship that a single traveller lives in, seen whole in one exterior view from the front left, landed on a pale peach desert plain under a clear pale aqua sky. It is a home first: a broad, rounded, slightly boxy hull like an old travelling caravan, a wide cockpit window at the bow with a sun visor, a side door amidships at the top of a short ramp, and set out around it for a stay: a striped canvas awning unrolled from the hull over a little porch deck at the top of the ramp, a folding table and two mismatched chairs under it, a hanging lamp, potted plants in crates along the rail, a big water tank strapped to the side, a washing line strung from an antenna to a pole with a shirt and a towel on it, a small round perch by the door for a little drone, a ladder to the roof where a solar panel is propped up. Patched mismatched hull panels, hand-painted repairs, rivets, a rounded engine pair at the stern, short sturdy legs with round pads. Worn cream enamel, muted lavender panels, a single coral stripe, teal and rust awning, a dark scorched scar on its flank. Inside it (not shown) a cockpit at the bow, a main room with a galley, a dining table and a reading corner, a small laboratory, a bunk room and a cargo hold. Shared scale: a cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands at the foot of the ramp, small against the ship; the ship is about 40 metres long and 12 metres tall, the door about 3 metres tall. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream and lavender, coral and teal accents, peach sand, aqua sky, lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, spacious calm composition, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, collage, cutaway, turnaround, diagram, multiple ships, fighter, saucer.
